full_prompt_en: The square image is a densely detailed isometric illustration of a miniature urban block, viewed from above at an oblique angle. Pale stone and painted façades rise in close rows around a narrow central street, their rooflines stepping upward toward the top edge. The buildings vary in height and shape: some have flat roofs with terraces, others carry dark pitched roofs, small dormers or box-like rooftop structures. Windows form repeated grids in cream, blue-grey, ochre and muted teal, with a few open shutters and tiny awnings adding colour. The largest pale building occupies the centre foreground, its angled corner facing the viewer and its roof terrace crowded with minute figures. More people line the balconies and upper walkways at left and right, while dense streams of pedestrians fill the street below. At this scale, individual clothing is not fully legible, but the small silhouettes vary in posture and colour, suggesting people standing, moving and gathering at railings. Near the centre, a round red parasol sits on a rooftop terrace, distinct from the many small yellow, blue and green awnings scattered across the façades. Compact green trees soften the lower corners and appear between the buildings. Narrow lanes and tiny ground-level stalls weave through the architecture, though their small signs are too indistinct to read. The scene uses fine, dark outlines to separate façades, roof edges, windows and ledges. Cool grey, cream and muted green dominate, while terracotta roofs and bright fabric accents provide scattered warmth. Light is even and daylight-like, with short shadows beneath roof overhangs and balconies that preserve the layered depth. Despite the crowding, the image remains carefully organized: repeated windows and parallel roof lines create order, while irregular building heights and pedestrian clusters keep the surface lively. The façades turn at sharp angles, exposing two sides of each corner block at once. Narrow sidewalks and tiny shopfronts run beneath the upper storeys, while small roof structures and rooftop furnishings occupy the ledges above. Tree crowns form soft green interruptions among the hard edges, most visibly near the lower corners and beside the central block. The fine scale invites close reading, but no single small sign or face is large enough to identify. Small colored awnings punctuate the pale walls and make the street grid easier to follow. The overall composition compresses a complex miniature city into a coherent square view, balancing dense architectural detail with small pockets of trees, colour and open street space.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的高密度等距插画，以倾斜俯视角描绘一片微缩城市街区。浅色石墙与彩绘立面沿狭窄街道紧密排列，屋顶线向画面上缘逐级升高。建筑高度和形状各不相同：有些屋顶平坦并带露台，有些则有深色斜屋顶、小老虎窗或方盒状屋顶构筑物。奶油色、蓝灰色、赭色和低饱和青绿色窗格重复成组，少量打开的窗板和小遮篷点出色彩。画面中央前景是一座最大的浅色建筑，斜角朝向观者，屋顶平台上挤满细小人物。左右两侧阳台与高处步道也站着许多人，下方街道则有密集人流。在这样的尺度下，衣着无法逐一辨清，但小小的剪影姿势和颜色各异，能看出有人站立、行走或聚在栏杆边。靠近中央，一把红色圆形遮阳伞立在屋顶露台上，与散布在立面上的许多黄、蓝、绿色小篷区分开来。紧凑的绿树柔化了下方两角，也零星穿插在建筑之间。窄巷与街面小摊穿行于建筑群中，但招牌太小而无法辨读。细密深色线条分隔立面、屋檐、窗户和平台边缘。整体以冷灰、奶油色和低饱和绿为主，陶土色屋顶与亮色布料点缀带来零星暖意。光线均匀，近似日光，屋檐和阳台下的短影保留了层叠深度。尽管画面拥挤，布局仍井然有序：重复窗格和平行屋顶线带来规律，而参差建筑高度与人群聚集又让表面保持活力。立面以锐角转折，使许多街角建筑同时露出两个侧面。狭窄人行道和微型店面穿行在上层建筑之下，屋顶边缘还摆着小型构筑物和平台陈设。树冠以柔和绿色打断硬朗边线，最明显地分布在下方两角及中央建筑旁。丰富的细节适合近看，但没有哪一处小招牌或面孔大到能够辨认。浅色墙面间点缀着彩色小遮篷，使街道网格更容易辨认。整体构图把复杂的微缩城区压缩在方形画幅内，在密集建筑细节、少量树木、色彩点缀和开放街道空间之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The isometric illustration uses precise outlines, repeated geometric units and many small variations within a tightly controlled structure. Muted stone, cream, grey-green and blue tones provide a steady base, with occasional brighter accents distributed across the surface. Fine details remain crisp at multiple scales, while repeated edges and angled planes make the dense image readable. Light is even and restrained; short shadows separate overlapping levels without obscuring their outlines. The overall visual language is intricate but orderly, balancing repetition with irregular clusters and carefully spaced colour notes.
style_prompt_zh: 等距插画采用精确轮廓、重复几何单元，并在严谨结构中加入许多细小变化。低饱和石色、奶油色、灰绿和蓝色构成稳定底色，少量较亮色彩分布在画面各处。不同尺度的细节都保持清晰，重复边线与倾斜平面使密集画面仍易于辨读。光线均匀克制，短阴影分开叠压层次，却不遮蔽形体边缘。整体视觉语言细密而有序，在重复规律、不规则聚簇与经过安排的色彩点之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Crowded isometric city block with rooftop terraces and a red parasol
theme_zh: 屋顶露台、红伞与密集人群构成的等距城市街区
name: Jan van Haasteren
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
